name: Plain
description: An API-first customer support platform and infrastructure designed for B2B SaaS teams, featuring full API-UI parity and native AI agent support.

evidence.claim: Plain provides a GraphQL API with full API-UI parity.
Authentication is handled via Machine Users and API Keys using Bearer tokens.
Plain offers a native MCP Server for AI agents to access the GraphQL API.
The platform includes a typed TypeScript SDK for its GraphQL operations.

notes: Plain is explicitly built as an API-first platform with a GraphQL API and native Model Context Protocol (MCP) support, making it highly suitable for AI agent integrations.
